entities.name: Glarb
entities.description: A frogfolk wizard, king of the frogfolk and ruler of Fountainport, who stole Maha's egg after visions of Valley's destruction.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: The city Glarb gently ruled from his throne atop its tiers.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: The home region Glarb sought to protect from Calamity Beasts.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A student of weaving whom Glarb briefly taught.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A weasel mercenary who helped Glarb steal Maha's egg.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: A Calamity Beast whose egg Glarb stole.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Powerful beasts whose threat to Valley haunted Glarb's visions.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of a party that investigated the Calamity Beasts and returned Maha's egg.

events.summary: Visions of Valley's destruction by Calamity Beasts haunt Glarb's dreams for many seasons.
events.quote: Visions of Valley's destruction at the paws and talons of Calamity Beasts haunted Glarb's dreams for many seasons

events.summary: Glarb schemes with Cruelclaw to steal Maha's egg, intending to raise the Calamity Beast as Valley's protector.
events.quote: he concocted a scheme with the help of the weasel mercenary Cruelclaw to steal Maha 's egg

events.summary: The theft causes an unprecedented rampage by Maha and the other Calamity Beasts.
events.quote: the theft of the egg caused an unprecedented rampage by Maha and the other Calamity Beasts

events.summary: Mabel's party gets an audience with Glarb, who admits he caused the Calamities' ire and summons Cruelclaw against them.
events.quote: the king revealed that he himself was the one responsible for the Calamities' ire

events.summary: Maha appears; Mabel soothes it by returning its egg, saving the plane.
events.quote: Mabel soothed the beast's wrath by returning its egg

events.summary: Glarb escapes the fight and flees Fountainport.
events.quote: Glarb escaped after the fight between him and Mabel’s party and fled Fountainport.

relations.quote: Glarb gently ruled the city of Fountainport from his throne atop its many tiers

the help of the weasel mercenary Cruelclaw

relations.note: He tried to have her party killed.
relations.quote: He summoned Cruelclaw to dispose of Mabel's party
